Titel: Power BI Developer Finance (m/w/d)
Unternehmen: Kestrel Analytics AG
Ort: Frankfurt am Main (Deutschland)
Quelle: LinkedIn
Link: https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/view/4125510392/
Abgerufen am: 18.09.2026 07:40

About the job
Our client, a listed industrial group, is modernising its finance reporting landscape. The Group Controlling and Group Accounting teams need a hands-on developer who turns SAP S/4HANA and consolidation data into a reliable Power BI platform for the CFO office.

Your mission
Design and build semantic models in Power BI and Microsoft Fabric for group reporting, IFRS consolidation and month-end close KPIs
Write performant DAX measures and Power Query transformations
Build data pipelines from SAP S/4HANA (CDS views) and the consolidation tool into a Fabric lakehouse
Implement row-level security for legal entities and cost centers
Set up CI/CD for Power BI artefacts with Azure DevOps and Git integration
Document data lineage and support the controlling team in self-service reporting

What you bring
3+ years of hands-on Power BI development (DAX, Power Query, data modelling)
Solid SQL skills, Python is a plus
Experience with Microsoft Fabric or Azure Synapse
Basic understanding of finance data (general ledger, cost centers, consolidation) - no accounting background required
Agile project experience (Scrum, Jira)
Fluent English, German is a plus

Engagement
Freelance, 6 months with extension option
Start: 1 November 2026
Rate: 850 EUR per day
Remote within Germany, 1 day per month on site in Frankfurt
